body:
Hello. 

The simulation only runs while Blender is playing, or if you manually advance the playhead on the timeline.  

If the simulation is still stuck even while playing, make sure the armature and bones are not muted, and try the `Rebuild Wiggle` button.
Oh, damn, that's so stupid—I hadn't noticed that detail in the videos... Thanks, it works now.
Glad to hear it's working! Thanks for confirming it was just that lol.
